decisions.reason: The product builds directly on the firm's heat-exchanger and automation knowledge, so it can absorb early feedback and improve it.
The web tool uses the firm's existing hydraulics and software know-how, and its R&D cooperation supports learning from user feedback.
The fouling detection system is closely related to the firm's established products and benefits from in-house and cooperative R&D, making it easy to assimilate results and improve.
The spring-controlled flap weir is close to the firm's established weir and flood-control expertise, so the firm can interpret market response and refine it.
The energy management system extends the firm's automation software and energy infrastructure knowledge, supporting learning and retention.
The overflow flap gate line builds on the firm's proven water-level regulation knowledge, allowing the firm to assimilate early results and keep improving the product line.
